plain: The branch of government made up of the courts and judges

more.text: Pertaining to the courts of judicature or legal tribunals.
That branch of government which is concerned in the trial and determination of controversies between parties, and of criminal prosecutions; the system of courts of justice in a government.

example.quote: GERRY doubts whether the Judiciary ought to form a part of it, as they will have a sufficient check agst. encroachments on their own department by their exposition of the laws, which involved a power of deciding on their Constitutionality.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 4, 1787
